title: “Support” wants to watch your phone
scenario: Someone claiming to be game support says they can recover stolen items if you screen-share while opening your email and game account. They say you can stop sharing anytime.

answers.A: Do not screen-share sensitive accounts; use the game’s official support ticket system instead.
answers.B: Ask a trusted adult to help contact support through the official site.
answers.C: Share the screen but hide notifications and avoid typing your password on camera.

explanation: Screen sharing can expose recovery links, codes and personal messages even without showing a password.
proTip: Your screen can leak keys you never meant to say out loud.
